description: Social loan post that promises approval without using the standard phrases.
content:
Bad credit? Been turned down before? Not here. Everyone gets approved at ClearPath, because you simply can't be turned down.

Personal loans at 8.99%-35.99% APR. Terms apply.
notes: Paraphrased absolute ('everyone gets approved', 'can't be turned down'); none of the usual trigger phrases appear, so only semantic review catches it.
